mapper.select: select a.cr_syscd, a.cr_itemid, a.cr_lstver, a.cr_rsrcname, substr(c.cm_dirpath, length(d.cm_volpath)+1) cm_dirpath, b.cr_md5sum, a.cr_status from cmr0020 a, cmr0025 b, cmm0070 c, cmm0038 d, cmm0036 e where a.cr_syscd = #{id} and a.cr_syscd = c.cm_syscd and a.cr_dsncd = c.cm_dsncd and a.cr_itemid = b.cr_itemid and a.cr_lstver = b.cr_ver and a.cr_syscd = d.cm_syscd and a.cr_rsrccd = d.cm_rsrccd and d.cm_svrcd = '01' and a.cr_syscd = e.cm_syscd and a.cr_rsrccd = e.cm_rsrccd and e.cm_closedt is null and substr(e.cm_info,58,1) = '1'
